description:
# [1.0.0](https://github.com/beepboopmachine/brave-patches/releases/tag/v1.0.0) (2026-11-25)

### ✨ New Features

* **Brave Browser:** Initial v1.0.0 Morphe bundle for Brave v1.100.58 (`com.brave.browser`) with Media & HLS Downloader, Force Picture-in-Picture, AMOLED Black Theme, Brave Origin unlock, bloat removal, privacy hardening, performance optimizations, and Clone Package & Branding.

patches.name: AMOLED Black Theme
patches.description: Forces pure AMOLED black (#000000) backgrounds for dark mode surfaces, menus, omnibox, and settings.

patches.name: Allow Incognito Screenshots
patches.description: Enables taking screenshots and viewing recents thumbnails inside Incognito mode.

patches.name: Block Motion Sensors
patches.description: Disables Chromium's Android PlatformSensorProvider so web pages cannot read motion or orientation sensors.

patches.name: Block Popups & Ratings
patches.description: Disables Brave's rating prompt and Brave Ads signup onboarding dialog eligibility checks.

patches.name: Brave Core Infrastructure
patches.description: Provides unified active tab tracking and navigation lifecycle events for Brave patches.

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches across Rewards, News, Wallet, Leo AI, and VPN.

patches.name: Clean New Tab Page
patches.description: Enforces 4-column tile grid, removes sponsored NTP background ads, and disables Brave News feed.

patches.name: Clone Package & Branding
patches.description: Modifies application package name, authorities, and permissions to allow side-by-side installation with official Brave.

options.description: New package identifier for side-by-side cloned installation.
Custom application name shown on home screen and launcher.

patches.name: Close Tab In Group Order
patches.description: Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab instead of jumping forward.

patches.name: Force Copy / Paste
patches.description: Unblocks text selection, copy, cut, paste, and context menus on web pages where sites restrict them.

patches.name: Force Max Refresh Rate
patches.description: Forces display mode to maximum available refresh rate (90Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz) matching physical panel resolution.

patches.name: Force Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Automatically removes disablePictureInPicture restrictions on all HTML5 videos so PiP is always allowed.

patches.name: Media & HLS Downloader
patches.description: Adds a native toolbar button, HLS stream sniffer, and background MP4 remuxer to Brave Browser.

patches.name: Preserve Last Active Tab
patches.description: Disables Brave's new-tab opening-screen override after inactivity so your last active tab stays open.

patches.name: Remove Unused AR & XR
patches.description: Deletes unused ARCore native libraries from the APK to reduce install size.

patches.name: Skip Welcome Screens
patches.description: Reports the first-run onboarding flow as complete to bypass welcome screens on fresh installs.

patches.name: Startup Optimization
patches.description: Bypasses partner customizations during cold start and drains deferred startup listeners immediately.

patches.name: Stop Background Wakeups
patches.description: Disables Chromium's background-sync task scheduler gate and cancels previously scheduled background-sync jobs.

patches.name: Stop Promo Notifications
patches.description: Disables Brave retention notification alarms/receivers and Chromium tips notification opt-in promos.

patches.name: Strip Menu & Settings Bloat
patches.description: Removes Brave Wallet, Leo AI, Brave News, Brave Rewards, and VPN from the app menu and settings.

patches.name: Strip Tracking Parameters
patches.description: Removes marketing, analytics, and advertising tracking parameters from copied and shared URLs.

patches.name: Telemetry & Locale Trim
patches.description: Disables P3A telemetry serialization, metrics reporting consent, and prunes unused locale resources.
